title: OpenClaw allow local Ollama models and select tool-capable model
script: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root='C:/3EN-Agent/openclaw-bridge';$work='C:/3EN-Agent/workbench';$cfg=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.openclaw/openclaw.json';$ep=Join-Path $root 'ollama-endpoint-v414.json';$base=(Get-Content $ep -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json).baseUrl;$tags=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri ($base+'/api/tags') -TimeoutSec 10;$models=@($tags.models|ForEach-Object{$_.name});if($models.Count -eq 0){throw 'NO_OLLAMA_MODELS'};$c=Get-Content $cfg -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;if(-not $c.agents.defaults.models){$c.agents.defaults|Add-Member -NotePropertyName models -NotePropertyValue ([pscustomobject]@{})};foreach($m in $models){$key='ollama/'+$m;if(-not ($c.agents.defaults.models.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains $key)){$c.agents.defaults.models|Add-Member -NotePropertyName $key -NotePropertyValue ([pscustomobject]@{})}};$c|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 50|Set-Content $cfg -Encoding UTF8;& openclaw.cmd gateway restart 2>&1|Out-Null;Start-Sleep -Seconds 3;$preferred=@('qwen2.5-coder:14b','qwen3:8b','deepseek-r1:14b','d89ftekb7/mistral-nemo-uncensored:12b-q4_0','dolphin-mistral:7b-v2.8-q4_K_M');$ordered=@();foreach($p in $preferred){if($models -contains $p){$ordered+=$p}};foreach($m in $models){if($ordered -notcontains $m){$ordered+=$m}};$winner=$null;$evidence=@();$i=0;foreach($m in $ordered){$i++;$target=Join-Path $work ('tool-probe-d-'+$i+'.txt');Remove-Item $target -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue;$prompt='Use the write tool to create exactly this file: '+$target+' with exactly this single line: TOOL_MODEL_OK . Actually call the tool. Then reply exactly TOOL_CALL_DONE';$out=& openclaw.cmd agent --session-key ('3en-057d-'+$i) --model ('ollama/'+$m) --message $prompt --json --timeout 120 2>&1;$code=$LASTEXITCODE;$ok=$false;if($code -eq 0 -and (Test-Path $target)){try{if((Get-Content $target -Raw).Trim() -eq 'TOOL_MODEL_OK'){$ok=$true}}catch{}};$evidence+=[pscustomobject]@{model=$m;exit=$code;fileCreated=(Test-Path $target);pass=$ok};Write-Output ('MODEL_TEST '+$m+' PASS='+$ok);if($ok){$winner=$m;break}};$evidence|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5|Set-Content (Join-Path $root '057d-model-tool-evidence.json') -Encoding UTF8;if([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($winner)){throw 'NO_LOCAL_MODEL_PASSED_TOOL_CALL'};$winner|Set-Content (Join-Path $root 'selected-tool-model.txt') -Encoding ASCII;$c=Get-Content $cfg -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;$c.agents.defaults.model.primary='ollama/'+$winner;$c|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 50|Set-Content $cfg -Encoding UTF8;& openclaw.cmd gateway restart 2>&1|Out-Null;Write-Output ('V433_057D_WINNER='+$winner)
